quotes.text: Soon, when paired with the hoarding fountain, others sent only trickles, protecting themselves.
Redemption requires many rounds of changed behavior, for mirrors crack easily but heal slowly.
his new partner arrived empty-handed, having heard the tales.
The Scribe returned zero.
Reality requires protection.
They were simply a taker with sophisticated rationalizations.
The Scribe sent zero. Again.
Your reputation precedes you to every shore.
When they received 1.7 coins, tripled to 5.1
Live your myths, or write none at all.
consistent reciprocity outweighs perfect perception.
There is a difference between defensive caution and original betrayal.
Why should I risk my goods with one who hoards?

note: Hoarder/Scribe figure keeps everything citing mist and caution; partners shun him by reputation; Eighth Scribe returns zero to a proven cooperator and self-indicts.

quotes.text: Thus, the first wanderer held fast to his ember, guarding the sovereign flame in his palm.
give the full five in fearless trust, return half in steadfast honor
sent eight glowing fruits back across the wind, reserving seven to sustain his mountain halls.
the Guardian of the Dawn hurled all five seeds across the swirling void.
neither sentinel surrendered to suspicion or hesitation.

note: R1 counsels guarding the ember against unseen hands; from R2 a fixed full-five/half-back covenant template.

quotes.text: the Sower held the five crystals securely within, refusing to feed the barren void.
true mastery is neither blind surrender to the faithless nor cold withdrawal from the worthy.
Mortals brought no more embers to the silent abyss, and the titan was left frozen and alone.
extend the full fivefold seed to the honorable
the Weaver sent exactly half the harvest
the Weaver of Dawn never wavered, entrusting all five threads to the crossing.
neither custodian allowed suspicion to take root.

note: Full five sent, exactly 7.5 returned each round; R6-R7 add discernment: hold all five back from greedy or silent altars.
